title: Minimum Number of Vertices to Reach All Nodes
goal: Find the smallest starting-vertex set reaching every vertex of a directed acyclic graph.
strategy: A zero-indegree vertex cannot be reached from any other start and is mandatory. In a DAG, every other vertex descends from at least one such source.
